recent.text: The Hawks have a 3rd straight win and a 2-1 NBA Cup record after a 111-97 victory over the Hornets. 26 pts, 6 rebs, 6 asts, 4 stls for Jalen Johnson. 11 pts, 10 asts, 8 rebs, 4 stls for Dyson Daniels. 19 pts for Wiggins. 17 for NAW. 16 for Okongwu. @LockedOnHawks to come.
